page.layout: One page of text, single column; running head at top centre; page number top left; below the text a faint show-through from the reverse side and a library stamp (not transcribed); an ornament (vignette) in the centre of the lower page.

main_text.p: Zoilus] Obtrectator studiorum alicujus, Cic. Homero-mastix.
Zona mundi ] Plaga, Virg. Fascia in coelo, Capell. Vid. Differ: in Ian. LL.
main_text.head: Soli DEO immortali, invisibili, qui dedit velle & perficere, sit laus & gloria, in sempiterna secula seculorum.

page.notes: The lower part of the page contains faint show-through from the reverse side, which is not transcribed. The ornament in the centre is a printer's vignette and is not text. The library stamp (Bayerische Staatsbibliothek München) is omitted. The word "Homero-" is hyphenated at the line end as printed.
